title: chi-chis.com, 1998 to 2004
lede: Three Internet Archive captures of the chain’s own site: its account of its history, its home page under Koo Koo Roo Enterprises, and the page that replaced everything in September 2004.

captures.title: “Chi-Chi’s History”
captures.text: The company’s own version: a corner of a Minneapolis bar, a first-year forecast of $400,000 and sales of $2M, 92 restaurants by year five.[^1]

captures.title: The home page
captures.text: Online ordering, a “Declaration of Salsafication” and a link to the parent, then called Koo Koo Roo Enterprises. The logo image was not archived.[^45]
captures.warn: The logo at top left did not survive in the capture.

captures.title: “Adios”
captures.text: One sentence. The page’s metadata gives its creation date as September 20, 2004, the day the Outback sale closed.[^19][^22]

snips.text: Chi-Chi’s origin is as remarkable as its success. It started in one corner of a Minneapolis bar (now known as the Richfield Chi-Chi’s)
Life always needs a little Salsa
